summary: Assist in designing and executing performance tests like load, stress, and endurance tests for our CRM platform. Learn how to push applications to their limits and make them stronger.
responsibilities: Assist in designing and executing performance tests like load, stress, and endurance tests
Work with tools like Apache JMeter (preferred), LoadRunner, or Locust to simulate real-world user scenarios
Help analyze system performance and identify potential bottlenecks across application and infrastructure layers
Learn how to monitor system metrics (CPU, memory, network, DB performance) using tools like Grafana, CloudWatch, or Prometheus
Support the engineering team in creating performance dashboards and reports to share insights and recommendations
required_skills: Basic understanding of performance testing concepts
Familiarity with any performance testing tool (JMeter preferred)
Some exposure to cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure
Comfortable with scripting (Python, Shell, or any language you know)
qualifications: Basic understanding of performance testing concepts
Familiarity with any performance testing tool (JMeter preferred)
Some exposure to cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure
benefits: Mentored by senior performance engineers and cloud experts
Work on live, production-scale systems — not dummy projects
Open, collaborative culture with room to experiment and grow
